references.text: This text is part of the larger legislation on inheritance rights that Moses received from the Lord, describing the order of inheritance when a man dies without sons.
Further provisions on inheritance rights that elaborate and limit the laws given in chapter 27, especially regarding daughters' inheritance and preserving tribal affiliation.
The law of levirate marriage (levirat), which also deals with preserving inheritance and the family name within the clan.
Provisions concerning the redemption of property through close relatives, illustrating the principle that inheritance and property should remain within the family.
The story of Ruth shows practical application of inheritance rules and the role of the kinsman-redeemer in preserving inheritance within the clan.
